system.description:
• Effect: Once per encounter, when you reduce a creature to 0 HP or below, recover one expended spell slot of a level up to half that creature's Level (rounded up, minimum 1st level). It must be a hostile creature that attacked you or an ally this encounter and was not Restrained, Paralysed, Unconscious or otherwise helpless, and never one summoned, created or controlled by you or your allies.
  • Example: kill a Level 6 creature, recover up to a 3rd level slot
  • Charisma Bonus: gain a permanent +1 to Charisma. This increases the DC of your spells and abilities, and all Charisma-based checks

activities.name: Dark Harvest
activities.text: When you drop a hostile creature to 0 HP, recover one expended slot of level up to half its Level (rounded up).
